integrity: The proof uses inspected analytic statements from the cited sources plus the elementary application of the sign lemma to \(-P\). No numerical experiment or computer certificate is used, and failed searches are not treated as novelty proof.
scientific_limitations: Existential only: no effective bound on \(|A|\), no minimum-cardinality result, no simplicity claim, and no assertion that one finite \(A\) has infinitely many extraneous zeros.
title: Arbitrarily many real extraneous zeros from finite weighted-Bergman zero sets
